title: Lender provides £900k for Buckhurst Hill mixed-use project
summary:
LendInvest has provided a refurbishment facility exceeding £900,000 for the acquisition and conversion of a semi-commercial property in Buckhurst Hill, Essex. The 18-month loan will fund the transformation of the site into a mixed-use development with a gross development value of £1.5 million.

title: Recognise Bank completes £5.35m hotel refinancing deal
summary:
Recognise Bank has completed two bridging loans totalling £5.35m secured against freehold hotels in West Sussex and Buckinghamshire. The 18-month facilities were completed at 70% LTV within 30 days for an operator with over 25 years' experience.

title: King’s Cross hotel portfolio secures £10m refinancing
summary:
A portfolio of three Grade II listed townhouse hotels in Argyle Square, Bloomsbury, has been refinanced with a £10 million term loan arranged by FRP Real Estate Advisory. The five-year facility was completed with minimal post-refurbishment trading history, with lenders underwriting forecast income.

title: Buy-to-let company formations decline for first time since 2008
summary:
The number of new buy-to-let company formations in Britain declined by 8% in the first eight months of 2026, marking what could be the first full-year decline since 2008. Research by Hamptons indicates the market has passed the peak of existing portfolio transfers as most landlords who benefit from incorporating have already made the transition.

title: Leasehold flat values fall 2.27% as freehold houses rise
summary:
Leasehold flats have declined 2.27% year-on-year to an average of £216,246, while freehold houses continue to appreciate across all categories. The research indicates nearly nine in ten leasehold flats remain on the market for more than six months amid mounting legal and financial pressures.

title: Estate agency gender pay gap widens to 28.7% in 2024
summary:
The gender pay gap in estate agencies has widened to 28.7% in 2023-2024, up from 24.7% in 2020-2021, according to analysis of official data from more than 25 major firms. The findings reverse earlier progress and show women's bonuses remain 48.7% lower than men's despite similar bonus participation rates.

title: Cyber attacks on estate agents rise 17% in past year
summary:
Cyber attacks against British property services businesses rose 17% in the past year, with 208 incidents recorded in 2025. Property insurance specialist Karis Insurance warns that estate agents and surveyors are increasingly targeted due to the extensive personal data they hold for compliance checks.

title: Berkeley warns buyers delaying purchases until Budget
summary:
Berkeley Group reports property buyers are postponing purchase decisions until after the 28th October Budget announcement. The housebuilder noted that while enquiry levels remain stable, customers without immediate moving needs are adopting a cautious approach amid speculation over potential tax changes.

title: Bank of England rate decision looms as mortgage costs rise
summary:
The Bank of England is expected to hold interest rates at 3.75% on Thursday, despite three MPC members favouring an increase. Mortgage rates have risen over the past 10 days as swap rates hit a three-year high, while mortgage approvals fell to 56,100 in July.

title: UK subsidence claims surge 140% amid record hot summers
summary:
UK insurers report subsidence claims up 140% year-on-year in August 2026 following consecutive record-hot summers. The average claim reached £20,000 between April and June, with insurers paying out £72 million compared to £60 million in the same period last year.
